evaluation.rationale: The notes capture the vast majority of the important information and action items from the transcript. However, they suffer from severe structural and conciseness issues. The follow-up draft is a 40-bullet list that simply repeats the entire notes rather than acting as a usable email draft. The structured lists (Action Items, Open Questions) contain extreme duplication, listing the same items 2-4 times. Additionally, the notes hallucinate resolved questions (Queuewise end date, Zendesk plan) as open questions, and state superseded values (120 agents, Q4 go-live) as current facts in certain sections. A summary bullet is also cut off mid-word.
